description: Retrieves values and statistics for a specified tag key on a Sentry issue, optionally filtered by environment. Use it to analyze tag value frequency and when values were seen.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for listing tag values for an issue.

environment.description: The name of environments to filter by.
environment.title: Environment

issue_id.description: The ID of the issue to retrieve tag values for.
issue_id.title: Issue Id

key.description: The tag key to look the values up for (e.g., 'level', 'environment', 'browser').
key.title: Key

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

name: list_a_tags_values_for_an_issue
